title: STORY COLLECTION: PINUS SYLVESTRIS OPEN
lines: 01 NEW STORY COLLECTION EVENT: PINUS SYLVESTRIS OPEN
EVENT DURATION: April 14, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 24, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
EVENT STAGES MAINLY DROP: Liść Tickets, Materials, etc.

DETAILS: Pinus Sylvestris event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain Liść Tickets from clearing all the stages except Annihilation and Extreme Mode to redeem event rewards and Information Fragments at the Prize Exchange Center. Information Fragments can be used to unlock the stories in Story Collection.
[PRIZE EXCHANGE CENTER] DURATION: April 14, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 24, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[PRIZE EXCHANGE CENTER] MAIN REWARDS:

Witch Feast Series - Grave Thief for Click, Furniture Piece: Ashlock's Mailbox, Furniture Piece: Fartooth's Windchimes, Information Fragments, Furniture Parts, Battle Records, Recruitment Permits, Elite Materials, etc.
NOTE:
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Intelligence. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Intelligence.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – A WANDERER IN THE WIND
DURATION: April 14, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 28, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "A Wanderer in The Wind", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Fartooth
★★★★★: Ashlock / Manticore
NOTE:
"A Wanderer in The Wind" belongs to "Standard Headhunting."
03 NEW OPERATORS AVAILABLE IN HEADHUNTING
DETAILS: The following Operators will appear at Headhunting "A Wanderer in The Wind", and will be permanently added to other Headhunting after in future update.
★★★★★★: Fartooth
★★★★★: Ashlock
NOTE:
Fartooth and Ashlock will gain more trust during this event.
04 LIMITED-TIME LOGIN EVENT: MAY THE SUNSHINE STILL
DURATION: April 15, 2022, 04:00 (UTC-7) – April 25, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can login for 7 days to earn the following rewards.
Day 1: Orundum * 200, LMD * 10000
Day 2: Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 3: Skill Summary - 2 * 15, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 4: Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, LMD * 20000
Day 5: Dragon Boat Bed (Head) * 1, Pure Gold * 55
Day 6: Originite Prime * 1, Strategic Battle Record * 10
Day 7: Dragon Boat Bed (Tail) * 1, Chip Catalyst * 1
NOTE:
The Top Emergency Sanity Potion from this event will be expired on May 2, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
